full_name: Judith Grant Long | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2011–2012 Social Sciences Joy Foundation Fellow Harvard Graduate School of Design
bio: Judith Grant Long is an associate professor of urban planning at the Harvard University Graduate School of Design, where her research examines the intersection of infrastructure and urbanism.
